selection_rule:
Out-of-pool universe selection (performance-blind).

Historical rule; the raw screener snapshot is not retained, so the exact draw cannot be regenerated from source:
  Source snapshot : Yahoo Finance equity screener, region=cn (7432 rows) and region=hk (3485 rows),
                    pulled 2026-09-08, sorted by market cap desc.
  Eligibility (no return / performance input whatsoever):
    CN-A : symbol *.SS/*.SZ, 6-digit code with board prefix in
           600/601/603/605/688 (SSE main+STAR) or 000/001/002/003/300/301 (SZSE main+SME+ChiNext);
           quoteType EQUITY; excludes B-shares (200/900), ETFs, Beijing Stock Exchange.
    HK   : symbol *.HK, numeric code 1..9999 (main board + GEM); quoteType EQUITY;
           excludes 11xxx-14xxx equity-linked instruments and 8xxxx dual/RMB counters.
    Both : firstTradeDate <= 2019-07-01 (so a full 2020-01-01 history is possible),
           marketCap present, regularMarketPrice > 0,
           liquidity floor on 3-month average daily turnover
             (averageDailyVolume3Month * regularMarketPrice):
             CN-A >= 50,000,000 CNY ; HK >= 10,000,000 HKD,
           code NOT among the 305 development-pool codes.
  Sampling:
    Eligible names are ranked by market cap and cut into 10 equal-count deciles.
    Within each decile the names are shuffled with numpy default_rng(20260908) and taken
    in shuffled order; the first N that pass the data-quality filter are kept
    (CN-A 15/decile = 150, HK 8/decile = 80).
  Nothing about historical return, drawdown, trend or strategy behaviour enters the rule.
caveats: DATA SOURCE DIFFERS FROM THE PROJECT POOL. The 305 development files come from akshare (Eastmoney/Sina) hfq; these come from the Yahoo Finance chart API, with hfq reconstructed from raw OHLC and adjclose. Cross-checked on 4 names that exist in both (000001, 600519, 00700, 01797): trading dates align exactly (0 project dates missing from Yahoo), daily-return correlation 0.9974-0.9999, largest single-day return difference 1.5-2.4 percentage points (dividend ex-date handling), cumulative adjustment-factor drift up to ~6% over 6.7 years. Good enough for a generalization check, NOT good enough to quote OOS numbers next to development-pool numbers to two decimals as if they were the same caliber.

No STAR-market (688xxx) and no ChiNext-registration (301xxx) names: the 'listed on or before 2019-07-01' requirement (needed for a full 2020-01-02 history) excludes boards that opened later. The 305 development pool contains both. Also no Beijing Stock Exchange names - Yahoo does not cover them (the dev pool has one, 920982).

SECTOR MIX DIFFERS FROM THE DEVELOPMENT POOL BY CONSTRUCTION. This universe is market-representative (Industrials 68, Technology 34, Basic Materials 27, Consumer Cyclical 23 of 230); the 305 pool was theme-picked toward tech/growth (software_internet 44, semiconductor_hardware 34, biotech_healthcare 29 of 305). Any OOS-vs-development gap therefore mixes overfitting with a style/sector-mix effect. Control for it by measuring per-stock excess over buy-and-hold INSIDE this pool, not by comparing raw OOS returns to raw development returns.

SURVIVORSHIP: the universe is a 2026-09-08 snapshot of currently listed, currently liquid names, so companies delisted between 2020 and 2026 cannot appear. The development pool also has survivorship bias, but not necessarily to the same degree; neither pool is point-in-time clean.

The liquidity floor uses the CURRENT 3-month average daily turnover, not a 2020 point-in-time value (no free point-in-time source is reachable from this host). It is a tradability/data-quality criterion and involves no return, drawdown, trend or strategy information, but it is not strictly ex ante with respect to 2020.

ST / *ST risk-warning status could not be filtered: the Yahoo name field carries no ST marker. The liquidity floor and the quality filter remove most distressed names, but some ST names may be in the CN-A set.

The reconstructed series uses the Yahoo adjustment history and a first-bar anchor. Absolute prices are not comparable across pools, and the observed adjustment drift means returns and derived indicators are close but not guaranteed identical to AkShare.

Sampling fractions differ by market: 150 of 2796 eligible CN-A names (5.4%) but 80 of 341 eligible HK names (23.5%). The HK eligible base is small because Hong Kong has few liquid pre-2019 listings outside the 99 already in the development pool.
Bars were fetched through 2026-09-08 and then trimmed to 2026-09-04, the last bar in the project's own backtest_data, so 'forced close at data end' falls on the same session in both pools.

23 candidates were drawn and then dropped by the quality filter (12 for a single-day close-to-close move above 90%, 11 for OHLC inconsistency above 5%); 15 of those were in the smallest HK market-cap decile. Each was replaced by the next name in the same decile's seeded shuffle, so the market-cap decile balance is exactly 15 per decile (CN-A) and 8 per decile (HK). 0 fetch failures.
